components.name: name
values: cross-species generalization of innate immune responses

components.name: task
values: tested on hagai et al. dataset lps stimulation of mononuclear phagocytes from pig rabbit mouse rat. models trained on three species and tested on holdout species mouse or rat in o.o.d. setting.

components.name: method
values: cae | autoencoder-based method that predicts perturbation responses via linear shifts in latent space.
identity baseline | predicts treatment effects by returning untreated states.
popalign | method based on aligning subpopulations of control and treated space approximated through a mixture of gaussian densities.
scgen | autoencoder-based method that predicts perturbation responses via linear shifts in latent space.

components.name: result_metric
values: l2 mean distance between observed and predicted mean drug effect

components.name: task
values: benchmarked against scgen cae and popalign.
cellot was applied to predict responses to cancer treatments using a proteomic dataset 4i of two melanoma cell lines m130219 and m130429 with 34 treatments and an scrna-seq dataset with 9 treatments.

components.name: method
values: cellot | cellot parameterizes the convex potentials of the dual optimal transport problem using input convex neural networks icnns . the optimal transport map tk is recovered as the gradient of the convex function gk gk . the map transports control distribution ρc to perturbed distribution ρk under minimal cost.

components.name: task
values: cellot learns an optimal transport map for each perturbation using input convex neural networks to map control to perturbed cell distributions.

components.name: task
values: modeled differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells over days 2 4 and 6. trained maps on oligopotent or multipotent cells and tested on the other o.o.d. .

components.name: dataset
values: kang et al. lupus ifn-β dataset

components.name: task
values: evaluated on a scrna-seq dataset of eight lupus patients treated with ifn-β. models were tested in i.i.d. and o.o.s. settings where a holdout patient was excluded from training.

values: cellot shows strong alignment of gene expression marginals for marker genes with bimodal expression profiles.
